| colspan="29" |Only guilds that have defeated Drone Matrix in raids 1-12 OR Reactor Epsilon in raids 13+ at least once are ranked.
Rankings are based on record over all raids: i.e. sorted by highest boss tier defeated, then highest # of times they have beat that boss tier

(so if two guilds have defeated Drone Matrix, then one that that has defeated it more times is ranked higher).

Key:

"A" = ATMOS. "R" = Reactor Epsilon. "D" = Drone Matrix. "G" = Guardian Gate.

"-" = guild did not participate in a raid (i.e. due to guild not existing or choosing not to attack).

" " (blank) = recent missing information (for ranking a blank is allowed in current/prior raid and is counted the same as previous non-blank result).

"?" = non-recent missing information (for ranking a "?" is counted the same as a "-").

If your guild is not listed or is missing information please submit your information to this [http://www.kongregate.com/forums/4496-general/topics/485491-raid-top-guilds-rankings-please-report-if-your-guild-has-finished-drone-matrix-or-higher-and-is-not-yet-ranked forum thread]
|}

== Details ==
Watchtower Raid Dates / Changes:
# 2015-03-10 to 2015-03-17
# 2015-03-17 to 2015-03-24
#* Devs altered the rules of the raid in order to nerf the "Hit & Run" tactic that Dark Phoenix published as an "easy" method to beat Drone Matrix & Reactor Epsilon (Now no points are earned on retreats, squad damage taken on a loss is at minimum the command pod health even if running a small number of units).
#* Color coding and descriptive text was added to Top Lists to clarify the requirements for maximum rewards (>=50% of highest scoring player).
# 2015-03-24 to 2015-03-31
# 2015-03-31 to 2015-04-07
# 2015-04-07 to 2015-04-14
# 2015-04-14 to 2015-04-21
# 2015-04-21 to 2015-04-28
# 2015-04-28 to 2015-05-05
# 2015-05-05 to 2015-05-12
# 2015-05-12 to 2015-05-19
# 2015-05-19 to 2015-05-26
# 2015-05-26 to 2016-06-02
#* At the League reset on 2016-06-01 Devs altered the rules of GA to remove squad health damage from PvP. This from that point, squad health can be 100% dedicated to PvE (i.e. raids and missions).
# 2015-06-02 to 2016-06-09
